name: PMTCT Audit Tool
description: Comprehensive PMTCT (Prevention of Mother-to-Child Transmission) audit tool with CQI indicators, EID integration, and mother-infant pairing

baseCohortDefinition.name: Pregnant women in PMTCT program during period

config.sql: SELECT DISTINCT pp.patient_id FROM patient_program pp INNER JOIN program p ON pp.program_id = p.program_id WHERE p.uuid = 'c4c19396-537b-4b4a-aa5c-1f83d09a2e30' AND pp.date_enrolled <= :endDate AND (pp.date_completed IS NULL OR pp.date_completed >= :startDate) AND pp.location_id = :location AND pp.voided = 0
